text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while taking a walk, I heard a familiar,
loud voice coming from the park...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said!!
Are we good to go with... this here?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Or like... "So tough!!"
...Kind of vibe... please do it like that!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and Daitaku Helios were having some sort of argument.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the disciplinary committee and party-girl Umamusume
are arguing, then surely—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's outside the academy on a day off,
I cannot overlook bad behavior, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? What a drag!
It's our day off, right?! Gimme a break, pleeease~â

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I. CAN'T. LET. THIS. SLIDE, SUUU!!
You're gonna write a full apology letter for this, su!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Is likely the kind of conversation taking place.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright!!
Then let's stick to the plan, boss!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy☆ All gucci~♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Actually,
it looks like Helios found a lost dog!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yep! I was out on a run, and I saw her wandering around looking super sad and teary☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Plus, Master-pi's prolly panicking right about now too, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, gotta go help out, I say!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And so, we were coming up with a plan to find the owner ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The owner might still be nearby,
so I'll use my loud voice to search—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Operation: Umastagram Shoutout so everyone notices me even from way far away, YAAAAAY☆"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
And I'm really sorry for everything!!

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You can't just go running off on your own like that anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I mean, if someone's in trouble, anyone would wanna help 'em out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
Though aren't we looking so fine thanks to "that"?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Helios and I
end up running together a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Is that another 'miraculously miraculous coincidence'?
Is this like the eighth time our running routes overlapped just this month?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even without planning it,
our times and places keep matching up!
Guess we've got some kind of destiny going on, huh!
choice_data_list: Let's keep getting along from now on.
Let's stay good friends from now on, okay?
Do we both have... psychic powers?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even without planning it,
our times and places keep matching up!
Guess we've got some kind of destiny going on, huh!
choice_data_list: Let's keep getting along from now on.
Let's stay good friends from now on, okay?
Do we both have... psychic powers?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Abandoning a bestie? Absolutely, totally not happening!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're already here,
wanna keep running?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay!!
Kick it into high gear!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them enjoyed
a pleasant, friendly run together.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Superpowers, you say?!
Wait, don't tell me we've got that kind of power?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously!? Crazy-crazy☆ Isn't that god-tier?
Super-duper cool!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to use this power
for the sake of justice, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I get to be a superhero!?
I'm so hyped!!
I've totally gotta brag to everyone later~☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa! If you're a hero,
you gotta keep your identity a secret!!
Plus, you should prepare a costume and stuff—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the two of them get completely into it,
it was far too late to say it was just a joke.
